update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Data collection interval, in seconds. Must be at least 60.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often to retry the initial connection when the job fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

subscription_ids.title: Subscription IDs
subscription_ids.description: Azure subscription IDs to monitor. They scope resource discovery.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: How the collector finds the Azure resources to monitor.

refresh_every.title: Discovery every
refresh_every.description: How often to refresh the discovered resources, in seconds. Zero disables rediscovery after startup.

mode.title: Discovery mode
mode.description: How resources are selected: `filters` (structured filters) or `query` (custom KQL).

mode_filters.title: Structured filters
mode_filters.description: Structured filters that select resources by resource group, region, and tags.

resource_groups.title: Resource groups
resource_groups.description: Azure resource groups to include. Leave empty for all.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Azure regions to include. Leave empty for all.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Exact-match tag filters. Keys match case-insensitively, values case-sensitively.

mode_query.title: Custom query
mode_query.description: An Azure Resource Graph query that selects the resources to monitor.

kql.title: Azure Resource Graph KQL
kql.description: Azure Resource Graph query selecting the resources. It must project `id`, `name`, `type`, `resourceGroup`, and `location`, plus `tags` for tag-based virtual nodes.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Which metric profiles apply to the discovered resources.

mode.title: Profiles mode
mode.description: How profiles are selected: `auto` (from discovered resources), `exact` (explicit list), or `combined` (both).

mode_auto.title: Auto profile overrides
mode_auto.description: Overrides applied on top of the profiles selected automatically.

entries.title: Profile entries
entries.description: Per-profile overrides applied only to profiles that activate automatically at startup.

name.title: Profile basename
name.description: Canonical profile basename. Must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores and start with a letter.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional per-profile resource filters that narrow the globally discovered set for this profile.

resource_groups.title: Resource groups
resource_groups.description: Azure resource groups this entry applies to. Leave empty for all resource groups.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Azure regions this entry applies to. Leave empty for all regions.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Optional tag filters for this profile. Supported only when `discovery.mode` is `filters`; in `query` mode, encode per-profile tag filtering in the KQL.

mode_exact.title: Exact profiles
mode_exact.description: Only the listed profile entries apply; nothing is selected automatically.

entries.title: Profile entries
entries.description: Explicit profile entries used by `exact` mode.

name.title: Profile basename
name.description: Canonical profile basename. Must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores and start with a letter.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional per-profile resource filters that narrow the globally discovered set for this profile.

resource_groups.title: Resource groups
resource_groups.description: Azure resource groups this entry applies to. Leave empty for all resource groups.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Azure regions this entry applies to. Leave empty for all regions.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Optional tag filters for this profile. Supported only when `discovery.mode` is `filters`; in `query` mode, encode per-profile tag filtering in the KQL.

mode_combined.title: Combined profiles
mode_combined.description: Automatic profile selection plus the listed profile entries.

entries.title: Profile entries
entries.description: Explicit profile entries merged with auto-discovered profiles in `combined` mode.

name.title: Profile basename
name.description: Canonical profile basename. Must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores and start with a letter.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional per-profile resource filters that narrow the globally discovered set for this profile.

resource_groups.title: Resource groups
resource_groups.description: Azure resource groups this entry applies to. Leave empty for all resource groups.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Azure regions this entry applies to. Leave empty for all regions.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Optional tag filters for this profile. Supported only when `discovery.mode` is `filters`; in `query` mode, encode per-profile tag filtering in the KQL.

query_offset.title: Query offset
query_offset.description: Minimum offset subtracted from metric query windows, in seconds. Increase it if metrics appear incomplete.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Timeout for Azure Resource Graph and Azure Monitor API requests, in seconds.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Caps on request concurrency and batch sizes for the Azure Monitor API.

max_concurrency.title: Max concurrency
max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent batch requests to Azure Monitor.

max_batch_resources.title: Max resources per batch
max_batch_resources.description: Maximum resources per Azure Monitor batch request.

max_metrics_per_query.title: Max metrics per query
max_metrics_per_query.description: Maximum metric names per Azure Monitor batch request.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How Netdata authenticates to Azure: `service_principal`, `managed_identity`, or `default`.

mode_service_principal.title: Service Principal
mode_service_principal.description: Service principal settings used when mode is `service_principal`.

tenant_id.title: Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Entra ID tenant ID. Required for `service_principal` mode.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Entra ID application (client) ID. Required for `service_principal` mode.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: Entra ID client secret. Required for `service_principal` mode.

mode_managed_identity.title: Managed Identity
mode_managed_identity.description: Managed identity settings used when mode is `managed_identity`.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of a user-assigned managed identity. Leave empty for a system-assigned identity.

virtual_nodes.title: Virtual Nodes
virtual_nodes.description: Creates Azure workload virtual nodes from Azure resource tags.

by_resource_tag.title: By resource tag
by_resource_tag.description: Azure resource tag whose value becomes the virtual node for the resources carrying it. Leave empty to keep everything on this host.

subscription_ids.ui:help: Add one Azure subscription ID per row. This job will monitor resources across all listed subscriptions.

cloud.ui:help: Select the Azure cloud environment that contains the subscriptions you want to monitor.

mode.ui:help: Choose how the collector finds candidate Azure resources: `filters` uses structured subscription/resource filters, while `query` runs your custom Azure Resource Graph KQL.

resource_groups.ui:help: Optional list of Azure resource groups to include. Leave empty to include matching resources from all resource groups.

regions.ui:help: Optional list of Azure regions to include. Leave empty to include matching resources from all regions.

tags.ui:help: Optional tag filters. Add a tag key and then provide one or more accepted values for that key. Tag keys are matched case-insensitively and values are matched case-sensitively.

additionalProperties.ui:help: Add one or more accepted values for this tag key.

items.ui:help: Allowed value for the selected tag key.

kql.ui:help: Provide a custom Azure Resource Graph KQL query. The result must include resource `id`, `name`, `type`, `resourceGroup`, and `location`. If `virtual_nodes.by_resource_tag` is set, project `tags` too; rows without object-shaped `tags` use the default host scope.
kql.ui:placeholder: resources | where tags.env == 'prod' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, location, tags

mode.ui:help: Choose how metric profiles are activated: `auto` enables profiles for discovered resource types, `exact` uses only the listed profile entries, and `combined` merges both.

entries.ui:help: Optional per-profile overrides applied only to profiles that auto-activate at bootstrap.
Add explicit profile entries for `exact` mode.

timeout.ui:help: Accepts decimals for sub-second granularity (for example, `0.5` for 500ms).

mode.ui:help: Choose how Netdata gets Azure credentials: `service_principal` uses explicit app credentials, `managed_identity` uses an attached Azure identity, and `default` uses the Azure SDK credential chain.

tenant_id.ui:help: Azure tenant ID for the service principal.

client_id.ui:help: Azure client ID of the service principal application.

client_secret.ui:help: Client secret for the Azure service principal.

vnode.ui:help: Optional virtual node name used to group charts from this job under a specific Netdata virtual node.
vnode.ui:placeholder: To use this option, first create a Virtual Node and then reference its name here.

by_resource_tag.ui:help:
Example: `workload` routes resources tagged `workload=api` to a virtual node named `api`.

In custom query mode, project `tags` in the KQL to enable tag-based virtual nodes; resources with missing or non-object tags stay on the default host scope.

query_offset.ui:help: Slower time-grain batches may use a larger effective offset automatically.
